verdict.rationale: 1Password ships an official CLI (`op`) with first-party get-started and reference docs, such as `op item list --vault Private`. A runtime probe independently confirms it is packaged in Homebrew as the 1password-cli cask (v2.39.0) and is the scriptable surface behind service accounts and secrets automation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-oriented CLI usage (e.g. machine-readable output or non-interactive agent workflows).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the official op CLI is packaged in Homebrew as the 1password-cli cask ('Command-line interface for 1Password', v2.39.0) — the scriptable surface behind service accounts, Connect, and secrets automation.
